findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed an open package of pre-cooked taco meat that is used to make taco burgers in the meat cutting walk in cooler that was date marked 11/1 and an open container of artificial crab to not be date marked in the meat walk in cooler. Taco meat was discarded during the inspection and crab meat was dated. Make sure to date mark all ready to eat, time and temperature controlled for safety foods with the date of opening or preparation and hold no longer than 7 days maximum. 
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment:
Observed an employee cutting produce in the produce cutting area while chewing gum. Employee was addressed and gum was disposed of at that time. Do not eat or chew products while preparing open, unpackaged foods as discussed.
750-530a Employees shall consume food only in designated dining areas. An employee dining area shall not be so designated if consuming food there may result in contamination of other food, equipment, utensils, or other items needing protection.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Sanitizer bucket in the butcher shop tested at 0 ppm. Wall unit was dispensing appropriately once run for about a minute as there was an air bubble in the hose that passed.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed deli slicer in the butcher shop to be soiled with food debris. Employee stated they only clean this at the end of the day. Deli slicer should be washed, rinsed and sanitized at least every 4 hours in use.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

750-1280 Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.citation_text: 750.130 - Raw foods (pork loin, fish, and chicken kabobs) were stored above ready to eat foods in the meat walkin cooler. Plate of chicken kabobs were also stored on top of a box of fish. All foods were moved to raw food storage area of the meat walkin cooler. All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination. Store ready to eat foods above/away from raw foods. Store raw meats properly in the order of their cooking requirements with the lowest required temperature products on the top and the highest required temperature products on the bottom. (i.e. fish above all other raw foods, poultry below all other raw foods, etc.) Do not store raw foods above/intermixed with ready to eat foods and cleaned/sanitized equipment.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - Multiple food items were observed on the floor in the walkin freezer and walkin dairy cooler. Employee working in the freezer stated the foods were not just delivered today, and he had been working to get everything put away on shelves since the store opened. Store foods up off the floor at least 6 inches to protect packaging and foods from potential cross contamination.

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.citation_text: 750.530 - Employee drinks with twist caps and a re-useable coffee cup with drink splash on it were stored above/next to foods and clean equipment on shelves in the meat prep room. Employee drinks were discarded during the inspection. Store employee drinks separate from food and clean equipment - use cups with lids and straws in prep areas. **Employees must wash their hands between drinks.**

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text: 750.880 - A) Bag of single service boxes were observed on the floor in the back hallway storage area. B) Sleeve of blue meat Styrofoam trays was observed on the floor by a pre table at the meat counter. Store single service articles elevated at least 6 inches off the floor to protect packaging and items from potential cross contamination.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.citation_text: 750.1120 - Handsinks in meat prep areas had wet rags in the basin, and the back handsink also had a dust pan and broom in it. Rags, dust pan, and broom were removed from the sinks during the inspection. Handsinks are to be used for handwashing only and accessible for handwashing at all times. Use handsinks for handwashing only, and do not store anything in the handsinks for any reason.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750.1120f - Handsinks at meat prep area were soiled due to presence of wet rags, a dust pan, and a broom being stored in the basins (see #31). Handsinks and all related fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the handsinks daily/as needed and maintain them clean to prevent potential cross contamination during handwashing. It defeats the purpose of handwashing if sinks and fixtures are soiled. **Do not store anything in handsinks for any reason.**

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1280 - Hooded sweat shirts were hanging on shelving units next to/above produce and single service articles in the produce prep room and back hallway storage area. A coat was observed hanging on top of crates of milk in the dairy walkin cooler. Store employee belongs separate from food and all food related items (i.e. single service articles, cleaned/sanitized equipment, etc.). Provide a separate area for employee belongs to be stored properly.
